agent.name: Special Dark Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technological significance, contrary evidence and anti-hype qualification

analytical_question: What significance classification is defensible for this defined system, with what confidence, and how much should it influence this organization's present chart-review decision?
general_et_finding: Classification: INCREMENTAL under the closed teaching premises. This usable deterministic system improves formatting within an existing activity. No convincing categorical barrier or substantial capability discontinuity is stipulated. Suppression restores earlier formatting methods. All six criteria NOT SCORED; no Promethean inference.
application_finding: Proposed incremental formatting convenience only; this control is not an observed implementation.
organization_specific_finding: For this closed negative control, ordinary formatting convenience does not justify a strategic classification or adoption command. It can be evaluated on its own modest value, permissions and maintainability. The control does not demonstrate real savings; keep report ownership and do not borrow the agentic-system label.

evidence.claim: Apply the sequential course instrument and distinguish facts, case premises and interpretation.
evidence.source_or_reference: S0 Chapter 11 sections 11.2 and 11.7; S1-S6 evidence/source_register.json
evidence.evidence_type: Course framework plus bounded original-source packet
evidence.notes: No source establishes chart-review outcomes. Candidate views are supplied analyses, not independent verification.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Convenience is not a new capability category under the control premises.
A different system that changes a constitutive constraint would require a new input and evidence; this modest control cannot rule that out.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High conditional confidence in the incremental classification given the stated control premises; no measured enterprise benefit or general-world performance is established.
value_opportunity_implication: A small formatting improvement may be useful if maintenance and error costs justify it; no real gain has been measured.
risk_governance_implication: Inflated language could obscure an adequate simple solution. Preserve source correctness and the named report owner.
recommendation_management_implication: INCREMENTAL under the closed control premises. Evaluate modest formatting value against existing rules without an inflated significance label or adoption mandate. A usable system need not create a new capability category.
change_monitoring_triggers: Application owner supplies measured task quality and full cost: reconsider modest local value.
The unit or capability changes substantially: request a new case rather than relabel this unchanged formatting control.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request actual correctness, maintainability and full-cost results for any real use.
The closed formatting control is not evidence of agentic capability or multi-tier dissolution.
